mission: Make Prometeo the operational memory so the human can forget or abandon the current ChatGPT conversation while a durable Chat Object preserves the complete design, rules, work state and worker results, and disposable one-shot workers execute prepared jobs without human context/result transport.
human_goal: The human should be able to forget everything except `Prometeo` or a tiny launch code. The parent must know what it is doing, what workers were actually launched, which returned, what failed, what remains, and the smallest next human action without asking the human to reconstruct memory.
current_frontier: Observed canary only: launch P-ZM-01 in one completely fresh ChatGPT conversation and prove durable STARTED -> transcript-independent RETURN -> DONE -> parent observation/integration. Full B-CHATOBJ-01 fan-out remains gated until this passes.
current_human_action: Open a fresh ChatGPT chat and send exactly `Prometeo P-ZM-01`. Do not paste any explanation. After that worker reaches a terminal response, the human does not need to copy its answer; returning to a parent incarnation with `Prometeo` or `.` is sufficient for the parent to inspect durable run/return state.
implemented_this_slice: Persisted SURVIVAL_SET_V1 with 35 binding continuity/orchestration requirements recovered from current and prior Prometeo designs.
Persisted ZERO_MEMORY_MODE_V1 so the parent acts as operational memory instead of asking the human to remember plans/workers.
Prepared B-ZEROMEM-01 / WI-ZM-01 with launch code P-ZM-01 and preallocated run RUN-ZM-01-A.
Pilot JOB requires exact STARTED file before recovery, exact durable RETURN, then DONE, with parent transcript forbidden as a dependency.
Work Board now distinguishes NOT_LAUNCHED from actual STARTED/WORKING/RETURNED/DONE and gates six-worker parallel fan-out behind canary PASS.
CHAT_OBJECT.json now loads the Survival Set and Zero-Memory Mode during reincarnation and records the exact pilot as current frontier.
must_preserve: Load SURVIVAL_SET_V1 before material architecture/runtime changes.
Human is not scheduler, collector, comparator, integrator, context bus or durable memory.
Conversation is disposable; Chat Object is durable identity/state.
No previous transcript is required for correct reincarnation or worker execution.
Agent Network independent state + derived views and EPOCH cheap freshness.
Execution/Work Packets and durable RETURN/recovery are reused rather than rebuilt blindly.
Current != Candidate != Human Accepted != Served != worker DONE.
Menu numbers and launch codes are aliases only.
One normal worker = one mission + one durable return.
STARTED must be durable before substantive worker execution; DONE requires durable return.
No shared mutable central worker-status file.
Parent remains useful while workers run and derives partial/full batch status from evidence.
Do not scale visible parallelism until one observed full canary cycle passes.
important_discoveries: The human-launch failure case must be first-class: prepared job + no run file means NOT_LAUNCHED, not stalled or done.
A preallocated pilot run id makes the first proof unambiguous: missing file means no durable STARTED; existing STARTED/BOUNDARY/DONE shows exactly how far the fresh worker got.

The strongest continuity pattern across earlier Prometeo versions is consistent: chat disposable, Written Mind/Active Method outside it, one mission/worker/return, human not scheduler/integrator/memory, and fresh-agent rehydration canaries.
Inbox/message transport is optional; JOB/Run/RETURN plus parent-derived state covers the core feedback requirement.
Survival requirements need their own durable checklist so a new model cannot silently simplify them away.
settled_decisions: Use Zero-Memory Mode now while the human may be forgetful/tired.
Require a single observed canary before launching P-CC-01..06 in parallel.
Pilot worker may write only its exact run and return files; it cannot mutate parent-owned state.
Parent verifies/integrates the pilot by reading GitHub, not by asking the human to paste worker output.
If the human forgets what to do, `Prometeo` must reconstruct the situation and tell them the smallest next action from durable state.
Optional ChatGPT history remains archaeology/evidence only.
negative_knowledge: Do not ask the human whether they launched a worker if durable run evidence can answer it.
Do not call a prepared worker started until its run file exists.
Do not call a worker done without durable return + terminal run state.
Do not launch the six-worker batch before B-ZEROMEM-01 passes.
Do not require the worker response to be copied back to the parent.
Do not reduce the product to Inbox/Outbox.
Do not treat transcript as database.
Do not rebuild prior Prometeo machinery before owner/history recovery.
Do not confuse latest commit/candidate with Current/Human Accepted/Served.
open_questions: Whether the fresh worker can create/update its run/return files with the currently connected GitHub transport exactly as specified.
After canary PASS, exact runtime/compiler changes needed for automatic derived batch projections and general non-preallocated worker ids.
Which historical SESSION_RETURN/rehydration/Planner/Compiler code should be reused directly after worker audits.
How fresh parent incarnation identity should be automatically registered without depending on platform thread ids.
next_actions: Wait for the one required human launch action: fresh chat -> `Prometeo P-ZM-01`.
On the next parent turn, inspect the exact expected run path and return path before asking the human anything about the worker.
If no run exists: report NOT_LAUNCHED and keep the same one-line launch action.
If STARTED/WORKING: report that the worker really began and inspect for terminal progress.
If BOUNDARY/FAILED: read reason/evidence, repair the protocol/job if possible, and rerun with a new explicit run slot.
If DONE + valid return: verify ordering/scope/recovered facts, record canary PASS/integration, then unlock B-CHATOBJ-01.
After PASS, launch the six P-CC jobs and derive partial/full progress without human result transport.
Finally test deleting/abandoning the parent conversation and reincarnating this exact Chat Object with batch state intact.
continuation_rule: Any future parent incarnation must load stable entry -> chat-object-prometeo-chat-control-main -> SURVIVAL_SET_V1 -> ZERO_MEMORY_MODE_V1 -> FOCUS -> WORK_BOARD -> relevant runs/returns. The current gate is B-ZEROMEM-01. Never revert to mailbox-first architecture or ask the human to restate the plan.
